concept:
1. 核心主体 (The Subject)

人物： Sun Yizhou as Lu Bu (孙艺洲饰演的吕布)

面部特征： sharp, confident expression with a mischievous smirk (犀利、自信的表情，带着一丝狡黠的坏笑)，actor Sun Yizhou's distinct facial features (演员孙艺洲独特面部特征)。

头部装饰： wearing a San-cha Shu-fa Zi-jin Guan (三叉束发紫金冠), a highly-ornate golden headwear with a central red jewel (装饰华丽的金色束发冠，中间嵌有红宝石)，two extremely long, flowing pheasant tail feathers (Zhi-ji Ling) trailing behind him in the wind (两根极长的、随风飘动的雉鸡翎)。

2. 服装与道具 (Apparel & Attributes)

铠甲： clad in a full suit of intricate ancient Chinese armor with mythical beast motif (兽面纹样) engravings, primarily in a striking combination of deep purple and gold (身着全套装饰复杂、刻有神兽纹样的中国古代铠甲，主色调为醒目的深紫和金色)，articulated shoulder guards (分体式肩甲)，glowing energy patterns embedded in the armor plates (铠甲片中嵌入发光的能量纹样)。

武器： holding a massive Fangtian Ji (Square-sky Painted Halberd / 方天画戟), a double-headed polearm with complex crescent-shaped blades (方天画戟，双头长柄兵器，带有复杂的月牙形刃)，the weapon's tip and edges are glowing with a powerful purple magical energy (武器尖端和边缘散发着强大的紫色魔法能量)。

3. 动作与环境 (Pose & Environment)

动作： a dynamic stand, facing the viewer directly, holding the Halberd diagonally (动态站立，直接面向观众，斜握方天画戟)，ready for an impending clash (准备迎接即将到来的碰撞)，a powerful, imposing presence (强大、威严的存在感)。

环境： standing on the tiled roof of the Forbidden City (紫禁城琉璃瓦屋顶), under a full moon night (满月之夜)，distant lights from the palace palace lights are visible far below (远处下方可见宫殿的微弱灯光)。

4. 光影与特效 (Lighting & Effects)

特效： a massive aura of crackling purple magical energy (罡气) radiating from his body and the weapon, creating sparks and particles (大量的破裂状紫色魔法能量罡气从他的身体和武器散发出来，产生火花和微粒)，subtle golden light particles floating in the air (空中漂浮着细微的金色光粒)。

光影： dramatic, high-contrast lighting (戏剧性、高对比度光影)，dramatic backlight (戏剧性逆光) highlighting the edges of the armor and the tail feathers (突出铠甲边缘和雉鸡翎)，volumetric fog and smoke (体积烟雾)，cinematic feel (电影质感)。

5. 艺术风格与质量 (Style & Quality)

风格： high-fidelity cinematic photo (高保真电影照片)，photorealistic (写实主义)，8k resolution (8k 分辨率)，highly detailed (高度细节)，Unreal Engine 5 render style (虚幻引擎 5 渲染风格)，epic fantasy concept art (史诗奇幻概念图)。
一致性优先级：面部特征锁定、服装细节锁定
需要稳定四视图参考，优先保证后续链式短视频生成的一致性。
